strawberry_jam.name: strawberry jam
strawberry_jam.description: Three berries simmered into a jar of jam. A hearty snack, or a little more gold than the fruit alone.

kabocha_soup.name: kabocha soup
kabocha_soup.description: A bowl of roasted kabocha soup. Restores more energy than eating the squash raw, and sells for more than the kabocha alone.

root_stew.name: root stew
root_stew.description: A carrot and a turnip stewed together. Warm, filling, and worth more than selling the roots raw.

bread_and_butter.name: bread and butter
bread_and_butter.description: A loaf split and spread with butter. More filling than eating them separately, and worth a little more gold.

jam_toast.name: jam toast
jam_toast.description: Toast with a spoon of strawberry jam. A sweeter snack than the jam alone.

strawberry_milk.name: strawberry milk
strawberry_milk.description: Cold milk stirred with a crushed strawberry. Restores more than the fruit and milk on their own.

buttered_kabocha.name: buttered kabocha
buttered_kabocha.description: Roasted kabocha with a melt of butter. Heartier than the squash raw, and sells for more than the two apart.

kabocha_cream_soup.name: kabocha cream soup
kabocha_cream_soup.description: A richer kabocha soup finished with milk and butter. The coziest bowl in the kitchen.
